# waxphx.salon

> waxphx.salon is a premium, one-of-a-kind .SALON domain name available for acquisition.
> It combines the geo keyword PHX (Phoenix, Arizona) with the high-intent service keyword "wax",
> making it the exact-match digital address for professional waxing and hair removal businesses
> in the Phoenix metro area.

## Key facts

- Domain: waxphx.salon
- Status: Available for sale (clean title, registrar-locked removal on escrow funding)
- Asking price: $50,000 USD — reasonable offers considered
- Escrow: all transfers completed through a licensed third-party escrow service
- Response time: within 24 hours
- Contact: sales@desertrich.com
- Location: Phoenix, Arizona, United States

## Market context

- U.S. hair removal and waxing services market growing at approximately 6% CAGR through the mid-2030s
- Phoenix metro population exceeds 5 million with strong in-migration and year-round demand
- The .SALON TLD signals an industry-specific, beauty and personal-care brand

## Intended buyers

Salon and spa owners, multi-location waxing franchises, mobile/at-home waxing services,
beauty booking platforms, esthetics academies, and domain investors seeking geo + service
exact-match assets.
